contracts.action: Relocate (Change folder…) is refused with reason "moving" while a group move runs
contracts.equivalent_path: The existing recording/exporting busy refusal in relocate and switch
contracts.before_after: Before: busy was inside the nested deps of the transaction. After: busy is on the top-level ActiveTransactionDeps, so the switch transaction checks it too. busyNow returns host busy, or "moving" when a move runs.
contracts.visible_effect: relocate-copy maps "moving" to relocateMoving, which is present in en and es.
contracts.failure_mode: No new async call. The busy check runs before the refusal, so a refused relocate leaves the state unchanged.
